title: feat(es7): Enable `es7.objectRestSpread`

comments.body: I blindly copy-pasted the solution suggested in an issue in `babel-loader` at first. Then I tried with `stage: 2` and this failed. Now I'm having `segfaults` on `npm run dev` :/

I deleted my `node_modules` and re-`npm install`-ed it and it is working fine. I think webpack might not like live-editing of `.babelrc`.

I've re-pushed with `stage:2`

> I deleted my node_modules and re-npm install-ed it and it is working fine. I think webpack might not like live-editing of .babelrc.

If you just upgrade node then you need to rm -rf node_modules indeed. Because some of the modules have native code compilation. Thus it can fail when upgrading major node.
Oh ok, makes sense. Thanks for the trick.
